title: Potential determination (FIE)
summary: Reaches a potential determination for each suspected disability category: criteria met, not met or insufficient evidence, and whether the student needs special education and related services. Independent reviewers apply the Texas criteria to an evidence table; the evaluation supervisor reviews every disagreement and signs.

values.label: Potential: criteria met; needs special education and related services
Potential: criteria met; no demonstrated need for services

notAssessed: The ARD committee makes the eligibility decision; this is a potential determination only.
notes: The determination stays potential until the supervisor signs, and enters the report only after that.

Deadlines (19 TAC §89.1011): the report is due by the 45th school day after written consent, extended by days absent when the student misses three or more; the ARD committee decides within 30 calendar days of the report; the parent gets the report at least five school days before that meeting. End-of-year exceptions apply.
School-day deadlines are estimated as weekdays; the school calendar is not linked.
Student records are protected (FERPA): web lookups for this type use only public regulations and test manuals, and carry no student details.
Criteria vary by state; this workflow uses the Texas criteria (19 TAC §89.1040).

inputs.label: Written consent and its date
inputs.help: Link or note the signed consent for evaluation and the date the district received it; the 45-school-day timeline starts there.

inputs.label: Referral concerns
inputs.help: Link the referral, or state who referred the student, when, and the concerns.

inputs.label: Suspected disability categories
inputs.help: Name the eligibility categories under consideration.

inputs.label: Data each suspected category requires
inputs.help: Data each suspected category requires (19 TAC §89.1040): for OHI, a physician, PA or APRN statement; for SLD, a classroom observation and data on appropriate instruction.

config.instructions: Build the evidence table: one row per score, observation or report finding. Copy scores exactly as the protocol or report gives them.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: The date the measure was given or the observation made

fields.label: Instrument
fields.description: The instrument, scale or procedure by name (e.g. a test's full name and subtest)

fields.label: Result

fields.name: area
fields.label: Area assessed
fields.description: The area the evidence speaks to: cognitive, academic, social-emotional, communication, motor, health, vision, hearing, adaptive

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: The suspected disability category the evidence bears on, if any

config.instructions: Find the date the district received written consent for the evaluation, the number of school days the student was absent since then, and the date of the written report, where stated.

fields.name: consent_date
fields.label: Consent date
fields.description: The date the district received written consent for the evaluation

fields.name: absences
fields.label: School days absent
fields.description: School days the student missed since consent, if stated

fields.name: report_date
fields.label: Report date
fields.description: The date of the written evaluation report, if stated

config.instructions: Check the evaluation against 34 CFR 300.304, using the evidence table in <items>.

checklist.label: All areas assessed
checklist.question: Is every area related to each suspected disability assessed (34 CFR 300.304)? Name any area left out.

checklist.label: A variety of sources
checklist.question: Does the evaluation draw on a variety of sources (tests, observations, parent and teacher input, records) rather than one kind?

checklist.label: No single measure decides
checklist.question: Does any category rest on a single measure? Name the measure if so.

checklist.label: Reads as a potential determination
checklist.question: Is the determination worded as a potential determination for the ARD committee, not a decision already made?

config.instructions: Rate only the suspected categories; mark others not_applicable by leaving them out. Rate each criterion from the evidence table and the sources, and cite the evidence for and against.

reviewers.label: Advocate
reviewers.brief: Build the case that each criterion of the suspected categories is met. Cite the evidence for it from the evidence table and the sources, and say how strong each piece is.

reviewers.label: Skeptic
reviewers.brief: Look for evidence against each criterion: contrary scores, missing required data (such as the physician statement for OHI or the classroom observation for SLD), and any category that rests on a single measure. Rate not_met or insufficient_evidence where the support is thin.

reviewers.label: Auditor
reviewers.brief: Apply the wording of each state criterion literally to the evidence table. Rate a criterion met only when every element the rule names is documented with a date and a source; otherwise insufficient_evidence.

config.instructions: Check the exclusionary factors (34 CFR 300.306(b)) and, for specific learning disability, the state's further exclusions (19 TAC §89.1040(c)(9)).

checklist.label: Appropriate instruction in reading and math
checklist.question: Does the evaluation rule out lack of appropriate instruction in reading or math as the determinant factor, with evidence?

checklist.label: Limited English proficiency
checklist.question: Does the evaluation rule out limited English proficiency as the determinant factor, with evidence?

checklist.label: Further SLD exclusions
checklist.question: If specific learning disability is suspected: does the evaluation show the difficulties are not primarily the result of a visual, hearing or motor disability, intellectual disability, emotional disability, cultural factors, environmental or economic disadvantage, or being an emergent bilingual student? Mark not_applicable if SLD is not suspected.

checks.label: Scores in the narrative match the evidence table
Written report due (45 school days from consent)

config.instructions: List each conclusion and each recommendation the report states.

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Statement
fields.description: The conclusion or recommendation as written

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: The disability category it concerns, if any

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Whether it is a conclusion or a recommendation

config.question: Does each conclusion and recommendation rest on evidence in the evidence table? Link the evidence rows it rests on.

config.guidance: Each suspected category's result (criteria met, not met, insufficient evidence) is worked out from the reviewers' agreement on its criteria. For each category whose criteria are met, judge whether the evidence shows the student needs special education and related services because of it: needs_services, no_need, or unclear when the material does not show it. Never rest a judgment on one measure. The value then follows from the categories: criteria_met when any category is met with a shown need; otherwise insufficient_evidence when any category is disputed, short of evidence or its need unclear; criteria_met_no_need when the met categories show no need; criteria_not_met when every rated category is not met. In the rationale, give every category's result, cite the findings and agreed items behind each need judgment, and list every disagreement for the supervisor.

guards.reason: a category rests on a single measure, or an exclusionary factor (instruction, English proficiency) is unresolved (34 CFR 300.304, 300.306(b)); see the result by category.

config.instructions: Review the potential determination and every disagreement with both rationales. Edit the value if the evidence supports a different one, then sign. The ARD committee makes the eligibility decision.
